purpose: Warn of an undesirable tendency that can arise without care.
keywords: ともすれば + tendency / negative outcome
People are apt to rely on familiar methods.
The discussion could easily become emotional.
When busy, we are liable to forget to check.
formation: ともすれば + tendency / negative outcome
restrictions: Often accompanied by がち or かねない.
mistake: It describes a risk or inclination, not a certain repeated event.
